steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the event.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the Technical response and RFQ quote, including the required terms acceptance.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the vendor-side event after submission.
Open the vendor's RFQ pricing round.
Verify the Technical-only clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second Technical-only clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer's event page.
